scoring.metric: official one-sided nearest-neighbor L1 surface distance in millimetres

randomization_test.null: the multiset of source-selected multipliers is exchangeable across target physical-object identities
randomization_test.enumeration: all unique allocations of seven 1.0, one 2.0, one 3.0, and four 4.0 multipliers to thirteen ordered targets
randomization_test.primary_statistic: object-balanced mean CD_UL1_mm; lower is better
randomization_test.tail: number of allocations no worse than the relation-preserving allocation divided by all allocations

secondary_diagnostics: same-object rank among all exact allocations
median and 95-percent central interval of exchangeable allocations
oracle per-object multiplier over the registered multiset support
source minimum-improvement versus held-out incremental-gain Spearman correlation
claim_boundary: This experiment is a retrospective relation-specificity diagnostic on the thirteen publicly materializable PokeFlex official-validation takes. It asks whether the same-object source-selected correction magnitude outperforms exact reassignment placebos while preserving the multiplier multiset. It does not create fresh confirmation, does not identify a unique causal material parameter, does not replace the five unavailable official takes, and does not authorize a direct comparison with the published eighteen-object aggregate.
